summary: Practise EVCA, risk mapping, accessible warnings and evacuation planning. Explore this five-day disaster preparedness training course.
lede: Inclusive disaster preparedness planning helps community practitioners identify access barriers and turn local risk knowledge into practical community plans. Designed for preparedness, risk-reduction and community-engagement officers, it develops skills in accessible consultation and participatory risk mapping, warning-channel design, and evacuation and shelter planning. You also practise documenting drills, gathering feedback and tracking corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who work directly with communities and partners to assess disaster risks, remove preparedness barriers and follow through on agreed actions.
prerequisites: Intermediate-level course. Working familiarity with disaster preparedness, disaster-risk-reduction activities or community engagement is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use assessment records, maps and planning documents.
